part.description: The published job openings from Next, and the posting of the one that is opened. Add the «Application form from Next» part to the page to take applications here

input.name: title
input.label: Heading
input.help-text: A heading set in the admin tool for Next is shown instead of this one

input.name: showCount
input.label: Show the number of openings
input.help-text: «4 ledige stillinger» as the first line under the heading. A choice in the admin tool for Next goes before this one

input.name: text
input.label: Text under the heading
input.help-text: Plain text. Line breaks are kept. A text set in the admin tool for Next is shown instead of this one

input.name: pageHeading
input.label: The heading of the page
input.help-text: Check when the page has no heading above the list: the heading here becomes the main heading of the page
